summary: Iteration 27: JWT Authentication with RBAC testing complete. All 22 backend tests passed. Frontend login, logout, RBAC sidebar visibility, User Management page, and unauthenticated redirect all working correctly.
passed_tests: POST /api/auth/login with valid admin credentials returns token and user object
POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials returns 401
POST /api/auth/login accepts email as username field ($or operator)
GET /api/auth/me with valid Bearer token returns user info without password_hash
GET /api/auth/me without token returns 401
GET /api/auth/me with invalid token returns 401
GET /api/users requires admin role (returns users list for admin)
GET /api/users without auth returns 401
POST /api/users creates new user with hashed password (admin only)
POST /api/users with duplicate username returns 409
POST /api/users with password < 8 chars returns 400
PUT /api/users/{id} updates user fields (admin only)
PUT /api/users/{id}/password resets password (admin only)
DELETE /api/users/{id} deletes user (admin only)
DELETE /api/users/{id} prevents self-deletion (returns 400)
Viewer role cannot access GET /api/users (returns 403)
Viewer role cannot access POST /api/users (returns 403)
Regression: GET /api/intelligence still works without auth
Regression: GET /api/cross-border/watch still works without auth
Regression: GET /api/daily-brief still works without auth
Regression: GET /api/dashboard/stats still works without auth
Frontend: Login page renders with username, password fields, and password toggle
Frontend: Password visibility toggle works (show/hide)
Frontend: Invalid credentials show error message
Frontend: Valid login redirects to dashboard with user info in top-right
Frontend: Logout clears token and redirects to /login
Frontend: Unauthenticated visit to / redirects to /login
Frontend: Admin sidebar shows User Management and Settings items
Frontend: Analyst sidebar hides User Management and Settings items
Frontend: Analyst redirected to /feed after login (not dashboard)
Frontend: User Management page accessible at /user-management for admin

Frontend: Generate password button creates 14-char password
Frontend: Copy password button appears after generation

auth.py: require_admin_role dependency correctly checks role before allowing access
AuthContext.jsx: Axios interceptors properly attach token and handle 401 responses
ProtectedRoute.jsx: Correctly redirects unauthenticated users to /login
